description: Source code for Kubernetes CronJob controller v2, managing scheduling, job creation, cleanup, and status updates for CronJobs.

classes.name: ControllerV2
classes.description: A controller for managing Kubernetes CronJobs, handling scheduling, job creation, cleanup, and status updates.

methods.name: NewControllerV2
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ControllerV2 instance with informers and event handlers.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller's main event processing loop with specified worker threads.

methods.name: worker
methods.description: Processes work items from the queue.

methods.name: processNextWorkItem
methods.description: Fetches and processes the next item from the work queue.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the state of a specific CronJob based on its key.

methods.name: resolveControllerRef
methods.description: Resolves a controller reference to a CronJob object.

methods.name: getJobsToBeReconciled
methods.description: Lists jobs associated with a given CronJob.

methods.name: addJob
methods.description: Handles job creation events, enqueuing the associated CronJob.

methods.name: updateJob
methods.description: Handles job update events, enqueuing the associated CronJob if relevant.

methods.name: deleteJob
methods.description: Handles job deletion events, enqueuing the associated CronJob.

methods.name: enqueueController
methods.description: Enqueues a CronJob for processing.

methods.name: enqueueControllerAfter
methods.description: Enqueues a CronJob for processing after a specified delay.

methods.name: updateCronJob
methods.description: Requeues a CronJob based on schedule changes or other updates.

methods.name: syncCronJob
methods.description: Reconciles a CronJob's desired state with current jobs, creating or deleting jobs as needed.

methods.name: cleanupFinishedJobs
methods.description: Removes old completed or failed jobs based on history limits.

methods.name: getFinishedStatus
methods.description: Determines if a job is finished and its finish type.

methods.name: removeOldestJobs
methods.description: Deletes the oldest jobs exceeding the history limit.

methods.name: deleteJob
methods.description: Deletes a job and updates the active list.

methods.name: getRef
methods.description: Creates an object reference for a runtime object.

methods.name: formatSchedule
methods.description: Formats the schedule string for a CronJob, including timezone info.
